descriptionByLocale.en:
Description of the Role

The research is aimed at selecting a CMO Manager, which will play a key role in the definition and management of the external production network globally. The figure will be responsible for guiding the performance of CMO partners, ensuring continuity of supply, economic efficiency and alignment to business objectives, operating as a strategic interface between the organization and the suppliers. The role involves the coordination of a team of 4 people (Switzerland and Italy) and a constant interaction with global stakeholders, in a dynamic and highly complex context.

Main responsibilities

1. CMO strategic management

- Selection, qualification and onboarding of new productive partners

- Management of existing CMO relations

- Performance monitoring (KPI: quality, time, cost, service)

- Supply Risk Management to Ensure Business continuity

2. Commercial and operational management

- Negotiation of supply contracts (MSA, Supply Agreement)

- Definition pricing, economic conditions and SLA

- Management of forecasts and orders

Requirements

- 5–10 years of experience in similar roles, preferably for pharmaceutical companies

- Consolidated experience in team management and development

- Great knowledge of the English language

Soft skills

- Strong relational capabilities and stakeholders management

- Problem solving and decision making

- Result orientation

- Ability to work in complex and regulated contexts

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission of the Role

The resource operationally coordinates the General Services team and presides over the services to support corporate plants, ensuring operational efficiency, security and regulatory compliance.

It operates as a link between Real Estate & General Services, HSE and Technical Services, ensuring the proper functioning of general services, security systems and maintenance activities connected to safety and work environments.

Main Responsibility

General Services Coordination

- Coordinate and supervise the General Services operating team.

- Manage facility soft and hard services in collaboration with Technical Services, in particular:

- cleaning and sanitation

- waste disposal

- security and access control

- pest control

- catering and vending services

- management of workwear

- Support the operational management of suppliers, monitoring performance, service quality and contractual compliance.

Business Plant Security – Supervisory, Access Control and Video Surveillance

- Coordinate the physical security of the corporate plants (pharma production sites and warehouses), ensuring the protection of people, assets and production processes.

- Operationally manage the supervisory and guardian services (armed and unarmed, portered), ensuring adequate coverage to the risk profile of the sites.

- Oversee access control systems (badges, authorization profiles, visitor management and suppliers), in coordination with HSE, Technical Services, Quality and IT, ensuring:

- segregation of sensitive areas

- traceability of access

- compliance with GxP requirements

- Coordinate video surveillance and security systems, ensuring the proper functioning of the systems and compliance with current privacy and data protection regulations.

- Collaboration with the management of critical events and emergency situations (intrusions, unauthorized accesses, security incidents), coordinating the actors involved.

Interface with HSE and Technical Services

- Operate as an operating connection between General Services, HSE and Technical Services for:

- integration of security measures with safety at work

- coordination of ordinary and extraordinary maintenance activities

- President of regulatory compliance on workplaces

- Support HSE in management of non-compliance, audits and inspections.

- Collaboration with the implementation of prevention and protection measures provided by current legislation.

CTF, Farmacia, Biologia, Biotecnologie o affini) - Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in Farmacovigilanza - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata - Conoscenza della legislazione e delle linee guida ICH, EMA, UK, Swissmedic, applicabili alla Farmacovigilanza. - Padronanza degli strumenti informatici
descriptionByLocale.en:
The resource will be inserted within the Drug Safety Unit (DSU) and will support pharmacovigilance activities related to IBSA products both in post-marketing and clinical development.

Main responsibilities

- Management of pharmacovigilance cases resulting from post-marketing experience, including:

- Collection, registration and management of adverse events/reactions (AE/ADR) EU and extra- EU from any source

- Download and manage Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSR) from EMA (EVWEB and MLM) and other national databases

- Notification to the Competitive Authorities (local EMA and NCA), where applicable

- Case follow-up activities

- Reconciliation activities with Business Partners, Service Providers and IBSA departments

- Preparation of Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRER) and ACO for IBSA products

- Support for the management of pharmacovigilance activities in clinical development, including:

- Revision of clinical trial documentation

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione del Ruolo La ricerca è volta alla selezione di un SAP Master Data Specialist con esperienza nella gestione, manutenzione e governance dei dati anagrafici all’interno dell’ambiente SAP (S/4 HANA) . La risorsa sarà responsabile dell’accuratezza, integrità e coerenza dei master data supportando le funzioni ed i processi aziendali. Il candidato ideale possiede solide competenze funzionali SAP, forte attenzione al dettaglio e capacità di collaborazione cross-funzionale. ## Responsabilità Principali ### Gestione Avanzata Anagrafica Materiali - Ciclo di Vita: creazione, aggiornamento e manutenzione dei master data in SAP - Configurazione Tecnica: gestione approfondita delle diverse tipologie di materiali, definendone caratteristiche, uso e flussi. - Data Enrichment: manutenzione dei dati di Classificazione e configurazione accurata delle viste MRP e delle altre viste gestionali per garantire il corretto funzionamento dei processi aziendali. - Data Quality: estrazioni massive dalle tabelle anagrafiche per attività di analisi e data cleansing (eliminazione duplicati e correzione inconsistenze). - Reporting: utilizzo della reportistica standard e custom per il monitoraggio dei materiali e delle strutture prodotto. ### Gestione Workflow e Troubleshooting - Workflow Management: monitoraggio e coordinamento del processo di creazione/modifica materiali, gestione degli utenti coinvolti e presidio delle strutture organizzative collegate. - Supporto: analisi degli avanzamenti dei processi e risoluzione dei problemi ( troubleshooting ) legati ai workflow anagrafici. - Configurazione: visualizzazione e controllo delle tabelle di configurazione per garantire il corretto funzionamento dei flussi automatici. ## Requisiti Tecnici e Competenze - Esperienza SAP: conoscenza profonda dei moduli MM (Material Management) e PP (Production Planning) . La conoscenza di SD (Sales and Distribution) o FI (Financial Accounting) è considerata un plus. - Transazioni e Tabelle: familiarità con le transazioni di gestione e capacità di interrogazione diretta delle tabelle SAP. - Tool di Caricamento Massivo: competenza nell'uso di transazioni per esecuzione di massive in SAP. - Data Analysis: padronanza di Excel per la manipolazione di grandi dataset. - Lingue: buona conoscenza della lingua inglese ## Soft Skills - Alto livello di precisione: consapevolezza che un dato errato può causare fermi produzione o scarti di materiali. - Problem Solving: capacità di risalire alla "root cause" di errori nei processi di business derivanti da master data incoerenti. - Comunicazione Efficace: capacità di mediare tra le scadenze del business e i rigidi vincoli tecnici del sistema ERP. ## Contatto (Non presente nella descrizione originale)
descriptionByLocale.en: Job Description The search is for a SAP Master Data Specialist with experience in managing, maintaining and governing personnel data within the SAP (S/4 HANA) environment. The resource will be responsible for the accuracy, integrity and consistency of master data supporting business functions and processes. The ideal candidate has solid functional SAP skills, a strong attention to detail and cross-functional collaboration capabilities. ## Main Responsibilities ### Advanced Personnel Data Management - Life Cycle: creation, update and maintenance of master data in SAP - Technical Configuration: in-depth management of various material types, defining their characteristics, usage and flows - Data Enrichment: maintenance of classification data and accurate configuration of MRP and other management views to ensure proper functioning of business processes - Data Quality: massive extractions from personnel data tables for analysis and data cleansing (duplicate elimination and inconsistency correction) - Reporting: use of standard and custom reporting for monitoring materials and product structures ### Workflow Management and Troubleshooting - Workflow Management: monitoring and coordination of the material creation/modification process, management of involved users and organization structures - Support: analysis of process advancements and resolution of problems (troubleshooting) related to personnel data workflows - Configuration: visualization and control of configuration tables to ensure proper functioning of automatic flows ## Technical Requirements and Competencies - SAP Experience: deep knowledge of MM (Material Management) and PP (Production Planning) modules. Knowledge of SD (Sales and Distribution) or FI (Financial Accounting) is considered a plus - Transactions and Tables: familiarity with management transactions and ability to directly interrogate SAP tables - Massive Data Loading Tool: competence in using transactions for massive data loading in SAP - Data Analysis: proficiency in Excel for handling large datasets - Languages: good knowledge of the English language ## Soft Skills - High Level of Precision: awareness that an incorrect data can cause production stops or material scrap - Problem Solving: ability to identify the root cause of business process errors resulting from inconsistent master data - Effective Communication: ability to mediate between business deadlines and rigid ERP system technical constraints ## Contact
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung des Jobs Die Suche ist nach einem SAP Master Data Spezialisten mit Erfahrung in der Verwaltung, Wartung und Governance von Personendaten innerhalb des SAP-Umgebungs (S/4 HANA). Die Ressource ist für die Genauigkeit, Integrität und Kohärenz der Masterdaten verantwortlich, die die Geschäftsprozesse und Funktionen unterstützen. Kenntnisse von SD (Vertrieb und Verteilung) oder FI (Finanzbuchhaltung) sind ein Plus - Transaktionen und Tabellen: Vertrautheit mit Verwaltungstransaktionen und Fähigkeit, SAP-Tabellen direkt zu befragen - Werkzeug für massive Datenerfassung: Fähigkeit, Transaktionen zur Durchführung von massiven Datenerfassungen in SAP zu verwenden - Datenanalyse: Profil für Excel zur Handhabung großer Datensätze - Sprachen: Gute Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache ## Weiche Fähigkeiten - Hoher Genauigkeitslevel: Bewusstsein dafür, dass ein falsches Daten kann Produktionsstillstände oder Materialabfälle verursachen - Problemlösung: Fähigkeit, die Wurzelursache von Geschäftsprozessfehlern zu identifizieren, die durch inkonsistente Masterdaten entstehen - Effektive Kommunikation: Fähigkeit, zwischen Geschäftsfristen und den strengen technischen Einschränkungen des ERP-Systems zu vermitteln ## Kontakt
descriptionByLocale.fr: Description du poste La recherche est pour un Spécialiste des données maîtres SAP avec expérience dans la gestion, la maintenance et la gouvernance des données personnelles au sein de l'environnement SAP (S/4 HANA). descriptionByLocale.fr: La ressource sera intégrée au sein de l'équipe de développement de protéines recombinantes et sera responsable de la gestion de cultures cellulaires eucaryotes, avec un focus particulier sur les lignées CHO. Elle contribuera au développement, à l'optimisation et à la maintenance des processus de production in vitro, en collaborant avec l'équipe de biochimie des protéines et de la traitements downstream. ## Principales responsabilités - Culture, entretien et manipulation de lignées cellulaires eucaryotes (notamment CHO). - Gestion de bioreacteurs en batch, Fed-batch et perfusion. - Transferts cellulaires et sélection de clones productifs. - Optimisation des conditions de croissance et de production protéique. - Suivi de la vitalité et de la densité cellulaire par des techniques standard (par exemple, comptage cellulaire, microscopie). - Soutien à l'échelle de cultures en flacons vers des bioreacteurs. - Préparation et mise à jour de SOP, de rapports techniques et de documentation de laboratoire. - Collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires (analyse biochimique de protéines, traitements downstream, analyse biologique). - Respect des normes de sécurité et des GMP/GLP, s'il y a lieu. ## Exigences - Diplôme de biotechnologie, biologie, pharmacie ou domaines connexes; un doctorat est considéré comme un plus. - Connaissances et expériences dans la gestion de bioreacteurs de laboratoire en batch, Fed-batch et perfusion, ainsi que la mise à l'échelle de cultures cellulaires. - Expérience confirmée (au moins 1-3 ans) dans les cultures cellulaires eucaryotes, préférablement CHO. - Connaissances de transferts cellulaires, sélection de clones et entretien de lignées cellulaires stables. - Connaissances de base des techniques de purification et d'analyse protéiques (SDS-PAGE, Western Blot, ELISA). - Bonnes capacités de résolution de problèmes et attention aux détails. - Excellentes compétences de communication et capacités de travail en équipe. - Anglais scientifique (écrit et parlé). ## Ce que nous offrons - Intégration dans un environnement de recherche dynamique et innovant. - Possibilités de croissance professionnelle dans le domaine biotechnologique et pharmaceutique. - Collaboration avec une équipe multidisciplinaire sur des projets à haut contenu technologique.
